QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` is an empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when GNU asm is available (`library/constant_time_impl.h:85-93`). Otherwise it XORs with a `volatile` zero global, so the compiler cannot prove a value at compile time

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states it is an empty asm volatile with the value as a "+r" input-output operand, and says it hides values from the optimizer (the barrier purpose).
